profile.description:
Welcome to 𝗛𝗼𝗿𝘀𝗲𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗢𝘂𝘁 — our aim is to help you understand your horse like never before.

Equine anatomy and biomechanics expert 𝗚𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗮𝗻 𝗛𝗶𝗴𝗴𝗶𝗻𝘀 brings the horse’s body to life in a truly unique way. Through stunning visuals, we reveal how horses move, how their bodies work, and how you can use that knowledge to ride, train, and care for them better.

This channel will give you fascinating anatomy insights and practical training advice that will help you:
- Improve your horse’s performance
- Train with empathy and understanding
- Boost overall well-being
- Minimise the risk of injury

Take a deeper look inside the horse. Once you see how beautifully and intricately the skeleton moves, you’ll never look at riding the same way again. We make it fun to learn about the anatomy, biomechanics and conditioning of the horse to improve performance, train sympathetically, enhance well being and reduce the risk of injury.

If you're an equine coach, therapist or professional with ideas, case studies or research to share. Have you thought about bringing your insights to life at the Horses Inside Out Conference 2027?

Mastering Scientific Posters with Professor Meriel Moore-Colyer shows
you how to turn your knowledge into a compelling, professional poster and inspire you with topic ideas and tips.

Discover the Science Behind Wellness and Welfare in Horses.

Sixteen scientific posters exploring the theme “Wellness and Welfare” will be on display at the Horses Inside Out Conference, February 20th and 21st February 2027. During breaks, authors will be available to discuss their research, and six will also deliver oral presentations of their posters during the conference.

This unique and inspiring scientific poster exhibition is designed to bring cutting edge, up to date information to  anyone who is passionate about learning and the science behind improving equine welfare and performance. 

With the theme "Wellness and Welfare - Supporting Equine Care, Training and Performance," this poster exhibition brings research to life in an accessible and engaging way. Explore how evidence-based knowledge and the latest scientific insights into biomechanics, movement, and training methods can be practically applied to working with horses.

top of pageUnderstanding How Your Horse Works Improves PerformanceHOMEContact UsJoin Email ListVolunteerABOUT USWhat We DoAbout GillianAbout PresentersGOOGLE REVIEWSTestimonialsVideosPhotosFAQsWHAT'S ONFull Event ListExhibitionConference 2027BHS COURSESCPD for TherapistsRiders & CoachesBespoke CoursesGet InvolvedSHOPPilates ProgrammeBooks with VideosBookseBooksPrints & PostersAnatomy ModelsACADEMYACADEMY HOMEAbout AcademyArticlesPublished ArticlesSEARCHMoreUse tab to navigate through the menu items.Please Log InAbout GillianBSc First Class Honours Degree, BHS Senior Coach, Dip (RM) MSM, ITEC (equine), MCAM, MIAS, MRAMP. Gillian is one of the leading equine anatomy and biomechanics educators in the world. Her work has improved the lives of thousands of horses and she inspires equestrians from all disciplines. Gillian is passionate about horses, equine anatomy and sharing all she knows for the good of the horse. 标题：Mastering Equine Scientific Posters with Professor Meriel Moore Colyer and Horses Inside Out
简介：If you're an equine coach, therapist or professional with ideas, case studies or research to share. Have you thought about bringing your insights to life at the Horses Inside Out Conference 2027?

Mastering Scientific Posters with Professor Meriel Moore-Colyer shows
you how to turn your knowledge into a compelling, professional poster and inspire you with topic ideas and tips.

Discover the Science Behind Wellness and Welfare in Horses.

Sixteen scientific posters exploring the theme “Wellness and Welfare” will be on display at the Horses Inside Out Conference, February 20th and 21st February 2027. During breaks, authors will be available to discuss their research, and six will also deliver oral presentations of their posters during the conference.

This unique and inspiring scientific poster exhibition is designed to bring cutting edge, up to date information to  anyone who is passionate about learning and the science behind improving equine welfare and performance. 

With the theme "Wellness and Welfare - Supporting Equine Care, Training and Performance," this poster exhibition brings research to life in an accessible and engaging way. Explore how evidence-based knowledge and the latest scientific insights into biomechanics, movement, and training methods can be practically applied to working with horses.

Learn more about our Poster Competition, Poster Presentations and Best Scientific Poster Award here - https://www.hioconference.com/science
